prerequisites: Ability to read and comprehend English texts

learning_outcomes.text: Ability to understand and apply advanced knowledge of high-performance computing and numerical or computational methods to engineering problems.
Develop skills to solve complex problems in the field of Engineering using High Performance Computing techniques.
Transform models into executable programs on infrastructures that the student is capable of designing and building.
Know how to compare and evaluate design or implementation alternatives to aid in professional and business decision-making.

assessment_rules: For ordinary assessment, a minimum grade of 4 out of 10 is required for the theoretical exam (EX), a minimum average grade of 4 out of 10 for the three practical assignments (EP1, EP2, EP3), and a minimum grade of 4 out of 10 for the final project (TR). If these minimums are met, the final grade is calculated as: 0.20 * EX + 0.40 * [(EP1 + EP2 + EP3)/3] + 0.40 * TR. Otherwise, the grade will be the minimum between the calculated note and 4. For extraordinary assessment, a minimum grade of 4 out of 10 is required for the theoretical exam (EX) and a minimum grade of 4 out of 10 for the final project (TR). If these minimums are met, the final grade is calculated as: 0.40 * EX + 0.60 * TR. Otherwise, the grade will be the minimum between the calculated note and 4. Grades are not carried over between calls.
